description: This PHP file defines the 'SaleTax' controller class within the Opencart admin backend, responsible for managing the sale tax report feature. It includes methods for rendering the report view, saving report settings, and generating the report data, handling user permissions, and interfacing with models and views specific to the sale tax report functionality.

classes.name: SaleTax
classes.description: Controller class for managing the sale tax report within Opencart's admin panel, providing functionalities to display, save settings, and generate report data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the language, sets page title, initializes breadcrumbs, and renders the sale tax report form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report settings via POST, includes permission check, and returns JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates the main sale tax report view, including order statuses and grouping options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the sale tax report list, calling getReport method.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches filtered report data, handles pagination, and renders the report list view.
